provenance.declaration: Requirements and black-box oracles were generated, causally checked, independently reviewed, and sealed in one transaction before any case was executed by Forge.
provenance.oracle_origin: Separate stateless generation and review requests per verified requirement; no Forge source or candidate implementation was supplied.
provenance.requirements_origin: Separate stateless generation and review requests per requirement from a domain-neutral benchmark brief; no Forge source, generated artifact, or prior blind case was supplied.
